in_hebrew.name: Zabina
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God's gracious gift
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Zabina הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew 'zabana' meaning 'gift of God' or 'gracious gift'. In the context of the early Christian church, the name Zabina would have held significant spiritual meaning, representing a gift or blessing from God. Historically, the name Zabina may have been used in Christian tradition to symbolize the idea of being set apart or sanctified by God. In modern times, the name Zabina is often associated with qualities such as purity, innocence, and devotion to the divine.
